context: Saito gives lifestyle advice to Yuki at a checkup.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: health advice; obligation/clinical forms (なけれ/行為) in natural home.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 少し、運動を増やさなければなりません。
lines.en: You need to increase your exercise a little.
lines.style: calm doctor voice, soft warm measured advising clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: つい、座りっぱなしになってしまい。
lines.en: I keep ending up sitting all the time.
lines.style: sheepish office woman voice, soft warm honest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 長時間座る行為は、体に負担です。
lines.en: Sitting for long periods burdens the body.
lines.style: clear doctor voice, soft warm measured advising clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 夜更かしも、やめなければですね。
lines.en: I have to stop staying up late too.
lines.style: reflective office woman voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 睡眠は、非常に大切です。守って下さい。
lines.en: Sleep is very important. Please protect it.
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm caring advising clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: つい夜更かししてしまい、反省します。
lines.en: I keep staying up late; I'll reflect on it.
lines.style: rueful office woman voice, soft warm sincere delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 無理のない範囲で、続けて下さい。
lines.en: Please continue within a comfortable range.
lines.style: warm doctor voice, soft warm encouraging caring clarity throughout
